subject: Observability evidence & audit-log export process
body:
From: Marta Ruiz <mruiz@horizon-fin.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai; procurement@horizon-fin.com
Cc: security-assessment@horizon-fin.com
Date: Mon, May 4, 2027 at 09:12 AM -0700
Subject: Observability evidence & export requirements for RFP - Horizon Financial

Hi Ben,

As part of our RFP we need a concise description of Redwood's audit log export and retention capabilities. Can you provide the following items or indicate where they live? We've attached a spreadsheet with our questionnaire (Horizon_Evidence_Request_05042027.xlsx) with the specific asks. Top-line items we need:

- Supported audit/event types (auth, admin, API calls, data access) and schema/fields exported
- Retention windows by product (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and whether custom retention is available
- Export formats (JSON/CSV/Parquet), sample export size, and typical throughput for extracts
- Evidence of non-repudiation (signed hashes, checksums, chain-of-custody) and tamper detection
- Operational SLA for producing ad-hoc exports (requested timeline and delivery mechanism: S3 presigned, on-prem courier, etc.)
- Any limitations (PII redaction, filtered views, deletion windows) we should be aware of

Please loop in whoever is best for technical details. We are on a tight schedule for procurement: would like a sample extract and playbook within a week if possible.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Senior Security Manager
Horizon Financial

Expect a follow-up from Lauren and David with exact formats and lead times.

Best,
Ben Carter

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <mruiz@horizon-fin.com>; ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: david_kim@redwood.ai; grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, May 5, 2027 at 11:20 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Observability evidence & export requirements for RFP - Horizon Financial

Hi Marta — Lauren here from Redwood Security. Quick answers to the bullets you submitted, plus operational notes below.

Supported audit/event types (high-level):
- Authentication events (login success/failure, MFA events)
- Authorization / permission changes (role grants, policy updates)
- API requests (model-inference calls, config changes)
- Admin console actions (user provisioning, key rotation)
- System-level telemetry (service restarts, node scaling)

Export schema and fields:
- Primary fields: timestamp (RFC3339), event_type, user_id (pseudonymizable), actor_ip, request_id, resource_type, resource_id, action, outcome, raw_payload (JSON)
- We can map fields to CSV, JSON or Parquet. Export includes a manifest.json with schema/verson and SHA256 of each file.

Retention windows:
- Hosted (default): 90 days of raw audit logs; 1 year aggregated metadata.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): configurable from 90 days up to 7 years by contract.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): retention controlled by customer; Redwood provides export tooling and recommended retention guidance.
- Note: log snapshots for legal hold can be retained longer in Dedicated/Private with an evidence package.

Export formats & delivery:
- Formats: ndjson (newline-delimited JSON), CSV, Parquet.
- Delivery: S3 presigned URLs (recommended), HTTPS transfer to customer-managed endpoint, or encrypted bundle via secure transfer service for private environments.
- Throughput: typical extract ~50GB/hour for Hosted exports when using parallel workers; Dedicated can be tuned higher.

Tamper evidence & chain-of-custody:
- Each export bundle includes: manifest.json, data files, and a signed manifest.sig (RSA‑2048 signature over manifest + file-level SHA256 checksums).
- We provide optional notarization: timestamped signature using our KMS and ability to provide PKI chain for verification.
- For forensic requests we can provide export receipts (who requested, which operator initiated export) and a sequential event audit showing export job lifecycle.

Limitations & redaction:
- PII redaction: configurable at export time; default exports include pseudonymized user identifiers, not raw SSNs/CCNs.
- Deleted data: if an event has been deleted under customer retention policy, it will not appear in exports beyond that retention window.

Operational SLA / lead times:
- Ad-hoc sample export (up to 24 hours of data): 48 business hours for Hosted. 24 hours for Dedicated if scheduled.
- Full evidence package (as requested in RFP): target 10 business days for Hosted; Dedicated can be expedited to 3–5 business days under contract.

Deliverables we will provide to Horizon:
1) Sample 24-hour export (ndjson + CSV) — anonymized
2) Export manifest + signed manifest.sig (RSA)
3) Step-by-step playbook: how to request exports and verify signatures (see attached playbook)
4) Chain-of-custody statement & timeline export for the sample

If you want a test extraction to land in an S3 bucket, send us a destination and creds (or we can generate presigned PUTs).

Thanks — happy to run a short tech call if you'd like to walk through the sample.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Security — Redwood Inference

From: Marta Ruiz <mruiz@horizon-fin.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai; ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, May 6, 2027 at 08:04 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Observability evidence & export requirements for RFP - Horizon Financial

Lauren — this is very helpful, thank you. A couple quick clarifications before we mark the questionnaire section complete: 

1) For the sample extract, can you confirm whether user identifiers will be pseudonymized by default or replaced with consistent pseudonyms so Horizon can correlate across days? We need consistent mapping for our internal analysis.

2) For the signed manifest.sig, can you share the verification steps we should run (example openssl commands) and whether Redwood will provide the public key in PEM format in the package?

3) Chain-of-custody: we need a short template statement we can include in our audit binder indicating who handled/exported the data and timestamps for each step. Is that automatically generated?

4) Lead time: sample within 48 hours is tight for us — can you confirm a calendar date for delivery and if the sample will contain redacted PII?

Also, please include an approximate file size for the sample so we can provision a bucket.

Regards,
Marta

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <mruiz@horizon-fin.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai; david_kim@redwood.ai; grace_oconnor@redwood.ai; procurement@horizon-fin.com
Date: Fri, May 7, 2027 at 04:40 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Observability evidence & export requirements for RFP - Horizon Financial

Marta — thanks for the follow-ups. Quick commitments and next steps: 

- Pseudonymization: sample exports will use consistent pseudonyms (stable mapping) so you can correlate across days. Mapping file will be included and encrypted; mapping keys are privileged and only shared under NDA/PO/contract.
- Verification steps: we'll include a verification guide with openssl examples and the PEM public key (public key file: redwood_export_pubkey.pem). Example command: openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_export_pubkey.pem -signature manifest.sig manifest.json
- Chain-of-custody: an automated export receipt is generated for each job (operator id, job id, start/end timestamps) and a templated statement is included. We will fill the template for the sample export.
- Delivery dates: sample delivery target = Tue, May 11, 2027 17:00 PDT (within 48 business hours of your confirmation). Estimated sample size: ~120MB (24-hour ndjson + CSV compressed).
- Full evidence package: target delivery = May 19, 2027 (10 business days) for Hosted. If you opt for Dedicated/Private with an expedited request we can target May 12–14.

Next steps we need from Horizon:
1) Confirm whether you want the sample in ndjson, CSV, or both.
2) Destination for export (S3 bucket ARN preferred) or we will generate presigned URLs.
3) NDA/PO routing for mapping file access (we can provide partial sample without mapping if preferred).

I've attached the playbook again and linked a short internal checklist in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/open?id=1A2B3C. I'll follow up with David to schedule a 30-minute tech demo to walk the team through verification and the manifest.sig process.

Ben Carter
Account Exec — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: AuditLog_Export_Playbook_v1.pdf; Horizon_Evidence_Request_05042027.xlsx
